analogy.rationale: p38 MAPK inhibitors block a stress-activated MAP kinase pathway that is largely quiescent in unstressed cultured cells, so transcriptional changes are modest; the closest reference class is the broader MAP kinase inhibitor, with JNK inhibitors sharing upstream stress-kinase signaling and other kinase inhibitors overlapping only weakly.
